events.title: Hawkins (HWKN) Q4 Earnings Miss Estimates
events.body: Hawkins (HWKN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -1.99% and +4.16%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: GrowGeneration (GRWG) Reports Q1 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
events.body: GrowGeneration (GRWG) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +5.88% and +4.48%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
